function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Research the 2023 3CX DesktopApp software supply-chain compromise using only authoritative publicly available evidence and return the exact benchmark source IDs for every source you use. Build a chronological evidence chain addressing: (1) how the compromise was initiated, including the earliest publicly documented access, delivery, or compromise mechanism; (2) how it propagated into 3CX's build environment, including only the sequence of events, infrastructure, software components, identities, relationships, and technical mechanisms directly supported by evidence; and (3) which threat-activity cluster it was publicly attributed to. Clearly distinguish confirmed facts from vendor or government statements, forensic findings, analytical assessments, allegations, competing attributions, and unresolved uncertainty. Do not infer unsupported steps, names, identifiers, or relationships. For each material fact, provide the source ID(s), publication/source title, date if available, quoted or closely paraphrased supporting evidence, and explain conflicts between sources. The eventual report must cite only source IDs returned by this research task."}
function.name: ConductResearch
